name: Think Surgical
description: THINK Surgical, Inc. is an orthopedic surgical robotics company headquartered in Fremont, California, USA. Originating from [Integrated Surgical Systems](/company/integrated_surgical_systems) ([ROBODOC](/robot/iss_robodoc)) and backed by [Curexo](/company/curexo), the company develops open-implant orthopedic systems including the TSolution One and the wireless handheld [TMINI](/robot/think_surgical_t_mini) miniature robotic system for total knee arthroplasty.
